explanation: Pairing by year and month finds the end of the same month a year earlier for every month end. Subtracting a year from 28 February 2025 gives 28 February 2024, which is not a month end in a leap year, so the date join loses February. LAG with no offset reads the month before, and LAG 12 over month ends that start in December 2024 has no row a year back.
